create.name: Mindful
create.bio:
Mindful, published at Mindful.org, is a secular mindfulness magazine and website that sets out to make meditation practical for people of any background or belief. It brings together guided practices, articles by meditation teachers and researchers, interviews, book reviews and a print magazine, with regular contributors and featured teachers such as Jon Kabat-Zinn, Sharon Salzberg, Kristin Neff, Judson Brewer and Vinny Ferraro. Its business and editorial office is run by Mindfulness United in Byron Bay, New South Wales.

The YouTube channel, active since 2015, is mostly short guided practices led by different teachers: breath and body-scan meditations, walking and forest meditations, loving-kindness and self-compassion sits, and brief daily resets. Mindful also sells self-paced online courses with teachers including Sharon Salzberg, Jillian Pransky, Cara Bradley and Elisha Goldstein, runs a 12-minute meditation podcast and offers its own app. Its free guides on how to meditate and its library of guided meditations are open to everyone on the website.

courses.title: Mindful Yoga Foundations with Jillian Pransky
courses.description: A self-paced online course combining gentle yoga with mindful awareness of breath and body, taught by Jillian Pransky.

courses.title: Mindful Movement with Cara Bradley
courses.description: A self-paced course in bringing mindful attention into movement, led by Cara Bradley.

courses.title: The Transformative Power of Mindfulness
courses.description: A self-paced online course from Mindful presenting core mindfulness practices with several teachers.

courses.title: Cultivating Forgiveness with UCLA Mindful Awareness Center
courses.description: A self-paced course with teachers from the UCLA Mindful Awareness Research Center on practising forgiveness with mindfulness.

courses.title: Get Started with Mindfulness with Elaine Smookler
courses.description: An introductory self-paced course for beginners on establishing a simple daily meditation, taught by Elaine Smookler.

courses.title: A Practical Guide to Daily Mindfulness
courses.description: Short lessons from various teachers on bringing mindful attention into ordinary daily activities.

free_resources.title: How to Meditate
free_resources.description: Mindful's free beginner's guide to meditation, with basic instructions and short guided practices to try. A good first stop for anyone new to sitting.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditations library
free_resources.description: A free collection of guided meditations from many teachers on the Mindful site, covering breath, body scan, loving-kindness and walking practice.
